content: ESA - ESA’s Mars Express unravels mystery of martian moon using 'fake' flybys Science & Exploration ESA’s Mars Express unravels mystery of martian moon using 'fake' flybys 02/12/2021 8593 views 99 likes ESA / Science & Exploration / Space Science / Mars Express By performing a series of real and 'fake' flybys, ESA’s Mars Express has revealed how Mars’ largest moon, Phobos, interacts with the solar wind of charged particles thrown out by the Sun – and spotted an elusive process that has only been seen at Phobos once before. The solar wind streams out from our star, filling the Solar System with energetic particles.
